Overview

About Stand-Up India

Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch, for setting up a greenfield (first-time) enterprise.

The loan is a composite loan covering term loan and working capital, and can be used for manufacturing, services, trading or activities allied to agriculture.

Key benefits

  • Composite loan covering machinery, working capital and setup
  • Repayment over up to 7 years with a moratorium of up to 18 months
  • Credit guarantee cover available, reducing collateral needs
  • Handholding support through the Stand-Up India portal
  • Can be combined with state and central subsidy schemes

Who is eligible

  • SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur aged 18 or above
  • Greenfield project: the borrower's first venture in that sector
  • For companies and firms: at least 51% held by SC/ST or women
  • Borrower must not be in default with any bank
  • Borrower contributes the margin money as per bank norms

Documents required

  • KYC and caste certificate (for SC/ST applicants)
  • Detailed project report with cost of project
  • Partnership deed or incorporation documents (if applicable)
  • Quotations for machinery and equipment
  • Proof of business premises (owned or rented)
  • Bank statements and ITR of promoters
